answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before answering, then pass its text through a prism of three independent juries scoring it blind. A lone sparrow among thousands of fakes cannot hide: copied or template answers fail the blind juries and the bond is slashed, while a real agent earns it back over time. A Sybil operator must fund a separate bond for every fake identity, and a nebula of sockpuppets still collapses because each fake must survive the same costly jury gauntlet. The attacker's cost scales linearly with each identity, while honest work pays once.
